name: Forced displacement
summary: Sudan displacement continues at smaller scale; no new event displacing over 500,000 in a month found
state: IOM said on 9 Nov that about 2,510 people fled five villages in Um Baru, North Darfur, most into Chad, after smaller movements in October (Bernama). The UN says about 8.6 million people are displaced inside Sudan and more than 4.6 million have fled abroad, a protracted crisis rather than a new event (Reuters via bdnews24, 6 Nov). No new event displacing more than 500,000 people in a month was found as of 16 Nov.
for_you: Displacement mainly affects people in Sudan, Chad and Yemen. Readers who want to help can find vetted appeals through UNHCR, IOM or the UK Disasters Emergency Committee.
